snippet.title: I'm back at it. Castlevania: Simon's Quest Revamped returns to development!
snippet.description:
More features. Fewer Bugs. The improved edition of CV2 Revamped is on it's way. Stay subscribed to get more updates.

UPDATE: I'm no longer posting download links here. Visit my discord server for updated information.
